landing.title: Shared expenses. Fairly balanced.
landing.lead: Balancia tracks what a group spends and works out who owes whom — on a server you control, with no third party in the middle of your money.
landing.registrationClosed: Registration is closed on this instance. Ask the administrator for an account, or use a guest invitation link if you have one.

splits.title: Splits that always add up
splits.body: Equal, exact, percentage or share-based. Amounts are whole minor units, so allocations sum to the total exactly — every time.

payers.title: Several payers, no workarounds
payers.body: When two people cover one bill, record it once. Balances follow who actually paid what.

currency.title: Multi-currency, two ways
currency.body: Keep each currency balanced separately, or convert everything into one base currency at a rate frozen when you record it.

passkeys.title: Passkeys and guest links
passkeys.body: Sign in with a passkey or a password. Invite people who do not want an account through a revocable link.

receipts.title: Receipts kept private
receipts.body: Attach photos or PDFs. They live in your own storage, behind authorization — never in a public folder.

recurring.title: Recurring expenses
recurring.body: Rent, subscriptions, the shared internet bill. Generated on schedule in your group's own timezone.

landing.selfHostBody: Balancia is free software under the AGPL-3.0-or-later licence. It runs from one Docker Compose file with PostgreSQL and a background worker, and the application sends nothing to third-party services and includes no telemetry.
landing.footerLicence: AGPL-3.0-or-later. Modified network versions must offer source.

adminTelemetry.description: What this installation shares, and with whom. Both switches are off until you turn them on, and nothing is sent in the meantime.
adminTelemetry.usageHelp: Send anonymous statistics about this Balancia installation, such as the Balancia version and which features are being used. One report a week.
adminTelemetry.usageNever: Expense amounts, names, email addresses, group names, receipts and other financial data are never collected.
adminTelemetry.crashHelp: Send the class of an error and the part of Balancia it came from — never the message, the stack trace or anything about the request.
adminTelemetry.modeLocal: This deployment records statistics locally and never transmits them. You can preview a report below; nothing leaves this server.
adminTelemetry.modeOff: Telemetry is switched off in this deployment’s configuration, so these switches cannot be moved.
adminTelemetry.saveFailed: That setting could not be saved.
adminTelemetry.previewHelp: Exactly what would be transmitted, built by the same code that sends it. Counts are ranges, not exact numbers, and there is no identifier for this installation.
adminTelemetry.notCollectedAmounts: Amounts, currencies of individual expenses, balances and settlements.
adminTelemetry.notCollectedNames: Names, email addresses, group names, descriptions, notes and comments.
adminTelemetry.notCollectedReceipts: Receipt images, the text read from them and attachment file names.
adminTelemetry.notCollectedIdentifiers: User, group and expense identifiers, session tokens and passkeys.
adminTelemetry.notCollectedInstance: This instance’s address, hostname, domain and IP addresses.
adminTelemetry.testHelp: Sends the report above now, so you can confirm it reaches the endpoint. Nothing is sent unless you press it.
adminTelemetry.testFailed: The report could not be sent.
